leakGuard.description: The private_key field of a Google Cloud service-account JSON key file: a PEM private key inside a JSON string.
A PEM or OpenSSH private key block (RSA, EC, OPENSSH, PGP and others).
An AWS access key id (AKIA..., ASIA..., ABIA..., ACCA...).
A GitHub token: ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_, ghr_ or a fine-grained github_pat_.
A Slack token: xoxb-, xoxp-, xoxa-, xoxo-, xoxs-, xoxr-.
A provider key that starts with sk- (sk-..., sk-proj-..., sk-ant-...), 20 or more characters with a digit.
A Hugging Face access token: hf_ and exactly 34 letters or digits.
A Google API key: AIza and 35 more letters, digits, - or _.
A value given to a name such as api_key, client_secret, access_token or password: quoted with 12+ characters, or unquoted with 16+, and containing a digit. Only the value is replaced.
A payment card number: 13 to 19 digits starting with 2 to 6, spaces or dashes allowed, that passes the Luhn check.
A Japanese Individual Number (My Number): 12 digits, 4-4-4 with spaces or dashes allowed, whose last digit is the check digit of the official formula.
A US Social Security number written 3-2-4 with dashes or spaces, in the ranges the SSA assigns: not 000, 666 or 900-999 first, not 00 in the middle, not 0000 last.
A US ITIN written the same way: 9 first, and 50-65, 70-88, 90-92 or 94-99 as the fourth and fifth digits.
